summary: Gain Therapeutics is a pre-revenue biotech with one clinical asset (GT-02287) targeting Parkinson's, now entering Phase 2 after FDA IND clearance. Its supply chain is minimal: R&D services and raw materials for drug substance, but the key risk is binary clinical trial outcomes and cash runway. The stock's extreme volatility reflects a single-asset binary thesis.

inputs.whyNeeded: Produces clinical trial drug substance and placebo
inputs.fragility: Low: many CDMOs available; switching possible but delays trial
Low: can reallocate if one site fails

chokepoints.node: Single drug asset GT-02287 in Phase 2
chokepoints.why: No other pipeline assets; failure = total loss of value
Pre-revenue; must raise capital or partner; dilutive if stock low

customers.node: Parkinson's disease patients via future sales
customers.why: Only potential end-market; no other commercial product

supplyChain.geographic: US-headquartered; clinical trials may be global but no supply concentration outside US
supplyChain.substitutes: Other GBA1-targeting or Parkinson's drugs from competitors (e.g., Bial, Sanofi); GT-02287 is not unique

bearCase: GT-02287 Phase 2 fails efficacy or safety, stock collapses to cash value (~$0.50-1.00). Even if positive, long time to market and need for partnership/capital, causing dilution. No revenue for years, cash burn erodes value.

loadBearing.assumption: Phase 2 data shows clinically meaningful benefit
loadBearing.breaksIf: Interim or final data misses primary endpoint or shows safety issues

loadBearing.assumption: Company maintains sufficient cash to complete Phase 2
loadBearing.breaksIf: Cash runs out before data; dilutive offering at low stock price

loadBearing.assumption: No competing drug gets approved first or renders GT-02287 obsolete
loadBearing.breaksIf: Competitor's GBA1 therapy succeeds with better profile

loadBearing.assumption: Regulatory path remains clear with FDA
loadBearing.breaksIf: FDA places clinical hold or requires additional preclinical studies

prediction.statement: Phase 2 interim data for GT-02287 in Parkinson's disease by mid-2027; positive results will trigger 50-100% rally, negative results will halve stock.
prediction.resolutionCriterion: Company announces Phase 2 interim efficacy/safety results; stock price reaction >20%

gaps: No financial details (burn rate, cash balance) to calculate runway
No competitor pipeline depth or trial design details
No information on CDMO contract terms or switch costs
verifyThese: Gain Therapeutics' cash balance and quarterly burn rate from SEC filings
Phase 2 trial design (patient numbers, endpoints, timeline)
Any existing partnerships or licensing agreements
diminishingReturns: Stopped at raw materials stage: deeper hops into CDMO supply chains (e.g., glass vials) are generic and do not change fragility profile. The critical fragility is clinical-stage binary outcome, not physical supply chain.
